title: Bi i dho husht
html_source: A corruption of the Irish, “Bí i do thost”, or “Be Silent”. The fact that the Citizen says “husht” rather than “thost” (pronounced “hawst”) suggests that he is mixing up the English word “hush” with the proper Irish word.
